findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: entite_lei, marches_publics · Private data: verifier_entreprise, rechercher_entreprise, qualifications_rge, procedures_collectives, entite_lei, gel_avoirs, marches_publics, surveiller_entreprise · Public sink: entite_lei, surveiller_entreprise.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: entite_lei, marches_publics · Private data: verifier_entreprise, rechercher_entreprise, qualifications_rge, procedures_collectives, entite_lei, gel_avoirs, marches_publics, surveiller_entreprise · Public sink: entite_lei, surveiller_entreprise

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "verifier_entreprise" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
